title: Give employees notice before workplace surveillance
what: Give workers written notice before surveilling them in the workplace, and conduct surveillance only as the notice says.

sources.title: Workplace Privacy Act 2011 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 13(1) (current republication (R6, from 23 June 2021; Workplace Privacy Act 2011 | Acts))
sources.quote: An employer may only conduct surveillance of a worker in a workplace if— (a) the employer gives written notice to the worker under this section

administration.who: Regulator under the Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (ACT)

reach.condition: if it carries out camera, computer or tracking surveillance of employees at work
